name: Look A Bazooka
detailed_description:
WHAT IS HAPPENING

The scientists at Rabbilla had the solution to the increasing worldwide demand for chicken meat: bigger chickens. Their genetic agent went out of control and now chickens are feral and gargantuan (but also dumber than ever). Accidental side effects of the genetic agent include being super effective on any other non-human living being, and pandas. Only one person, a genius of chemistry and luminar of science, can reverse the formula and save the world. No, no, that's not you. You're simply the best agent in the world and are tasked to find this genius!

WHAT IS THIS

LOOK A BAZOOKA is third person shooting game with minimalistic gameplay and a rich progression chain. The world has been taken over by gigantic creatures of every sort and you’re on a desperate search for someone able to bring humans back at the top of the food chain. Gather funds and characters in each mission to buy upgrades and new, over the top weapons.

Buy NOW for 48 whole hours of Even-Earlier-Early-Access *compared to anyone who will ever buy the game at least 48 hours after you

FAQs

This sounds like a lore-rich game! How do I skip cutscenes?

  • All cutscenes are skipped automatically. This option cannot be changed.

Is this game shovelware?

  • Yes, we really just wanted to exploit the universally-renowned IP of Look A Bazooka before it goes cold.

Is this game Euro jank?

  • Yes, it is in the Italo-jank subgenre to be precise

Is this a rogue like?

  • No, it is obviously a Look-a-like

Isn't this just a third person shooter?

  • Look A Bazooka is not a Third person shooter. By incorporating with the concept of shooting(bazooka), it's a totally brand new genre called third person shooter like/bazooka game(jump and bazooka system).

Was this game approved by PETA?

  • We didn't ask, but we can say that while no chickens were hurt in the making of it, poultry has occasionally been consumed by the dev team.

Was the game downgraded? The water puddles look worse.

  • Yes, we've downgraded the water puddles because we discovered they were distracting players from firing bazookas

Can I play as a tree?

  • It's highly Impossible, but not improbable. It makes perfect sense, trust me on this one.

What kind of replayability can I expect?

  • You can change the volume slider from 1 to 100, which means you can experience the game in at least 100 different ways.

  • And don't get me started about camera angles.

Is this made with AI?

  • Absolutely not, this game is made without any Intelligence, in any shape or form. The game has in fact been described as "stupid" many times.

Why are we shooting at these chickens?

  • Because chickens are reverse zombies and they hate you, it's all explained very clearly in the mission descriptions.

Was this made by a solo dev?

  • Absolutely, the real name of the developer is Arran David Duncan Lou Matt Pete Antoine Antonio Pete Steven Victoria Daniele Filippo Steve

short_description: Zone out for an afternoon of mindless jumping and shooting in this very first third-person-shooter-like. LOOK A BAZOOKA is a casual shooting game where you can destroy everything, together with your friends and family. Humanity is ending and only one man can save it; but he doesn't know.
